messages:
maria: Quick sync — thinking about calibration holdouts & linting for our quant profiles (FP8/INT8/4bit). Goal: detect silent quality regressions early and keep runtime simple.
aj: love it. what's the proposed holdout split? per-customer? per-workload? global?
kyle: Prefer hierarchical: global baseline holdout + per-model slice. Global catches broad regressions; per-model catches edge cases. Keep datasets small (1k-2k examples) so CI stays fast.
sophia: For evaluation, we need deterministic seeds and a saved checkpoint of prompts. otherwise flaky metrics kill trust. also request we log per-example diffs (but sampled) so engineers can inspect.
maria: Agree. Proposal: store calibration artifact with model build: {"calib_dataset":"eng-ml/holdouts/rep-2025-v1","seed":"42","sample_hash":"abc123"}. Use this for both calibration and eval.
aj: Can we add a lint step in model-pack CI that flags these things:
- missing calib artifact
- mismatch between profile declared precision and available runtime kernels
- >2% delta on median quality vs baseline
That would stop bad profiles from shipping.
kyle: Need to be careful with the 2% threshold — different metrics scale differently. Suggest we have metric-specific gates and a soft-fail (warning) vs hard-fail based on model tier.
sophia: Also run a reduced-quality checklist on PRs: sample outputs for 20 prompts, diff tokens and hallucination checks. Manual sign-off for any ambiguous failures.
ci-bot: build 5412 finished: quant-lint passed, eval run queued.
aj: Runtime interface question: do we surface calibration stats (scale ranges, per-layer outlier counts) in the model metadata for routing/rollback decisions?
maria: Yes. Runtime should be able to ask: "is this layer likely to overflow in FP8 given recent inputs?" So include numeric summaries: per-layer mean, std, max-abs, outlier-rate in the profile metadata.
kyle: Implementation detail: store stats as compact histograms (64-bin) + scalars. Runtime reads small blob, not everything. Also include a version tag so we can evolve format.
sophia: Operationally, we need lifecycle rules: when model is re-calibrated, preserve older profiles and keep eval checkpoints for 30d. That helps rollbacks and audits.
aj: Fallback policy idea: on-the-fly detect spike in outlier-rate -> switch to safer precision (e.g., FP8->INT8 fallback) for that model id for the next N minutes and trigger alert.
maria: +1. Add exponential backoff for flip-flop prevention.
kyle: Edge-case: mixed-precision kernels may not exist for all combos. Lint should fail if fallback path isn't implementable on target infra.
sophia: We should also add a small human-readable summary in the profile: "expected_quality_delta":"-0.4% median ppl vs fp16" to help SRE/product on-call triage.
aj: For tooling, proposal: "quant-lint" CLI that runs locally and in CI. Example:
```
quant-lint check --profile out/quant/v1.json --calib out/calib/stats.pb --eval out/eval/report.json
```
Outputs machine-readable pass/fail + human report.
maria: Nice. Last bit: make sure we track which prompt subsets triggered worst regressions and add them to the regression dashboard so we can prioritize fixes.
aj: I'll prototype the lint and a minimal metadata schema this week. I'll post a short RFC follow-up with examples.
maria: Thanks — assign to aj for prototype. tagging @sophia/kyle for review when ready. :rocket:
